turns.q: What do you do outside of work?
turns.answer:
Photography's the big one — street photography specifically, wandering cities with a Leica trying to catch the odd little moments most people walk past.[[street-photo]] I collect photography books too, and I nearly always have music on while I'm shooting or cooking. I also love to travel, and I'm drawn to places with a bit of a reputation.

turns.q: What do you do outside of work?
turns.answer:
Plenty, and it keeps me sane. I'm a street photographer[[street-photo]] — Leica in hand, wandering cities hoping a good frame turns up, which mostly it doesn't, and that's the game. I collect photography books, I nearly always have music on, and I love to travel, especially to places with a slightly dodgy reputation. When I'm not doing any of that I'm in Bordeaux[[bordeaux]] with my family.

turns.q: What do you do outside of work?
turns.answer:
Plenty, as it happens. I'm big on street photography — I shoot with a Leica rangefinder and spend a lot of time wandering cities looking for that one good frame that mostly never comes. I collect photography books, love cooking, and I've done a fair bit of travelling — I once spent a year working my way around South East Asia and India. I also used to DJ, and there's usually music on whatever I'm doing.
